main_text.head: AD HENRICVM II. Francorum regem de soluta vrbis Mediomatricum obsidione.

p.i: AELO vetustas intulit Herculem, Mirata monstris lethiferam manum: Flammisque stellatus refulget Saxificæ domitor Medusa. Si poscat æquo nuda sub arbitrio Virtus honores, impiger Hercules, Henrice, concedet priores Iure tibi, volucréque Perseus. Nam multiformi tu numerosius Hydra, Medusa pestiferum magis Monstrum repressisti, impetusque Prodigij retudisti inanes. Occasum & Arcton iam comitem trahens Et arma Eoa Carolus Austriæ Torrentis hyberni petebat More furens populator vrbes. Sub feminmauro [?] Cæsare, proh pudor! Germana virtus cesserat: Italum Indocta libertas tyranni Ferre iugum tacitè fremebat.

page.notes: The page number reads "8ı" and is given as 81 with uncertainty. The woodcut ornament at the left of the poem and the decorative band above the title are not text. "Sub feminmauro" is doubtful; it may be "femina auro". "Saxificæ" may carry a ligature. The final signature "F. j." is doubtful. No running head or catchword is printed.
